name: Jocaste
summary: In Darnassus, Jocaste trains night elf hunters arriving from the wilds of Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Enclave
sections.body: Jocaste trains night elf hunters in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. Young trackers come to her after their first training in Shadowglen, ready to take up the hunt in the capital. She teaches marksmanship and survival in the wild, along with the bond between a hunter and the beasts of Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Jocaste trains night elf hunters in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.
Find Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in northwest Darnassus on the boughs of Teldrassil.

faq.q: What role does she play for young hunters?
faq.answer: Young hunters come to Jocaste in Darnassus to advance their discipline through The Hunter's Path and learn to train and master wild beasts.

faq.q: Is Jocaste affiliated with the Cenarion Circle?
faq.answer: Yes. Jocaste trains hunters in the Cenarion Enclave and welcomes visiting hunters into the presence of the Cenarion Circle.

angles.text: As a night elf hunter arriving in Darnassus, Jocaste can refine your combat skills and help strengthen your bond with your animal companion.
As a night elf, you can see in Jocaste the harmony between your people, Teldrassil's wild beasts, and the teachings of the Cenarion Circle.
